title: Goya native foundation and first integrated proof (goya-hello)

scope.objective: Deliver GY-001 through GY-005: reconnaissance, contract closure, workspace bootstrap, native foundation crates, and a tested reproducible native proof application.

Vico Vee.correction_2026_11_04: GY-001 recon was wrong. The directive-relevant Vico Vee is the ViCo Execution Environment at ~/vico-desktop/src-tauri/vico-vee (v0.2.20): sandboxed execution service with Ed25519 capability grants, Landlock+seccomp-bpf isolation, budgets/cancellation, artifact store, REST API, and a lib target with 26 modules. See docs/contracts.md correction section. The ~/vee-gui Tauri app is only a discovery dashboard for Vee instances.

implementation_record.notes: std-only workspace; millipoint integer geometry for deterministic layout; single-writer revisioned state transactions with invariant-checked commits; synchronous event pipeline; headless software renderer emitting PPM frames.

results.goya_hello: pass — 4 frames rendered to target/*.ppm, count=2 after 3 increments, contracts GY-IR/1 GY-STATE/1 GY-LAYOUT/1 GY-RUNTIME/1
results.known_environment_defect: doctests cannot execute: rustdoc fails to load libLLVM.so.22.1-rust-1.95.0-stable on this host (toolchain issue, not code); doctests contain no asserted examples.

test_evidence.environment: rustc 1.95.0, cargo 1.95.0, Linux 6.18.7, Wayland session (WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1), wayland-client pkg-config present

performance_record.observation: cold debug build 0.96s for 5 crates; goya-hello run is instantaneous; formal baselines deferred to GY-WAYLAND-001 when frames reach a live surface

risk_assessment.wayland: Live surface not yet wired; proof renders headless PPM. Mitigated by contract boundary GY-RUNTIME/1 which the adapter consumes.
risk_assessment.determinism: Layout proven pure by unit test; renderer uses fixed tables. Text shaping is placeholder 5x7 glyphs — Wave 4 accessibility item.
risk_assessment.state: Single-writer transactions serialize; concurrent multi-store patterns arrive with Mesut integration (Wave 3).
